scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @yemesek/database exec prisma generate && sh scripts/with-db.sh tsc-watch -p tsconfig.build.json --onSuccess "sh scripts/start-compiled.sh"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @yemesek/database exec prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @yemesek/database exec prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: cd ../.. && eslint -c eslint.config.mjs apps/api/src apps/api/test services packages/database/src packages/database/prisma/seed.ts packages/database/prisma/seed-data.ts packages/shared/src packages/config/src
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @yemesek/database exec prisma generate && sh scripts/with-db.sh jest --runInBand
